prompt_markdown: Your team is shipping a citizen registration script with AI help.
Which of these is fine to delegate to the tool?

options.text: Deciding how long citizen records are kept.
Confirming the script handles messy input before it goes live.
Deciding the script is ready to ship.
Drafting the boilerplate for a function you have already designed.

why: Boilerplate is safe to delegate because you still check it. Retention, verification and the ship decision stay with you.
